templates.name: Email Analysis and Response
templates.description: Analyzes incoming email and drafts or sends a response via bridge-local execution

config.prompt: Analyze the following email and determine the appropriate response. From: {{from}}, Subject: {{subject}}, Body: {{body_masked}}. Consider: Is this spam? Does it require a response? What tone should the response use? Are there PII fields that need approval before including in a response?
